reason: My real problem is billable hours per client and blowing half my estimates, and nothing in this pitch says it tracks time. A client page that collects emails and tasks is nice, but it doesn't tell me which project is eating our margin.
objection: No time tracking per client, so I'd still be running Harvest or Toggl next to it and paying for two tools that don't talk to each other.
would_change_my_mind: Built-in timers that log hours against each client and task, with estimate-versus-actual reporting I can bill from.
